ns2:course.label: Screendance
ns2:course.description: Provides a comprehensive approach, from camera use to editing techniques, leading to a practical ability to develop and produce video projects on a basic level. Course focuses on developing choreographic projects designed specifically for the video/film format. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: DANC 330. Non-dance majors admitted by audition on a space-available basis.
